newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINNA UP ON BOURSE, TRADE MODEST.
newsitem.headline: TALLINNA UP ON BOURSE, TRADE MODEST.

text.p: * Total trade on the Estonian bourse on Friday was 39.8
million kroons versus Thursday's 37.7 million kroons.
* The Talse index lost 0.67 percent to close at 253.40.
* Hansabank was most active in turnover of 8.7
million kroons to lose 1.99 kroons to 131.71 kroons.
* Tallinna Bank was traded at 7.6 million kroons
to close at 62.05 kroons, 2.05 kroons higher than Thursday's
close.
* On the free market, Rakvere meat factory was in
relatively active trade again at 1.7 million kroons to close at
16.12 kroons or 0.12 kroons lower.
* Dealers said Tallinna Bank fell in the morning as a
response to a Aripaev report on its liquidity crisis, but
gained later as investors realized the stock was cheap and the
news was not so bad.
(A complete report follows)
(See index on stock exchange web site:
http://www.tse.ee/online/total.htm)

Tallinna Bank gained the most on Estonia's market on Friday after a newspaper report that it had faced a liquidity crunch earlier in the week pushed its price down sharply on Thursday and early Friday, dealers said.
Tallinna Bank gained 2.05 kroons to close at 62.05 kroons in trade of 7.6 million kroons.
"The newspaper report did not mean anything in essence and the price started to rise again," one dealer said, adding that the stock had fallen too far.
Rakvere saw active trade for the third day, but its closing price fell 0.12 kroons to close at 16.00 kroons.
Dealers said the stock is good an has potential to rise.

The market has suspected some investors might have had insider information on the Rakvere acquisition of the Riga meat factory, as the share became active and gained some days before the official announcement.
Hansabank fell 1.99 kroons to close at 131.71 kroons and Forekspank fell 1.00 kroons to close at 178.80 kroons.
Dealers said prices are low and might attract more buyers next week.
-- Eva Palu, Tallinn Newsroom, +372 630 8400, reuters@reuters.ee
